item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find solid 2024 reporting that directly documents Trọng using family nepotism, explicit favoritism in appointments, or pardon-trading for private advantage. The most relevant evidence is instead indirect: anti-graft purges that were real but party-led, plus heavy information control and selective punishment of critics.
